messages:
anna: seeing ResourceWarning/unclosed transport in a small service that creates clients per-request. minimal repro below.

diego: can you paste the repro + sdk version?

anna: redwood-py 1.2.0, python 3.11, httpx 0.24.2

```python
import asyncio
from redwood import RedwoodClient

async def handle(i):
    async with RedwoodClient() as c:
        await c.chat.create(prompt=f'hello {i}')

asyncio.run(asyncio.gather(*[handle(i) for i in range(120)]))
```

anna: behaviour: after ~40 tasks warnings about unclosed transports and sockets in CLOSE_WAIT. restart fixes it.

morgan: this smells like cancellation during __aexit__/aclose. we added a concurrency limiter that cancels waiting acquires; if teardown runs while cancel in-flight it can skip cleanup.

diego: quick mitigation: set REDWOOD_CLIENT_REUSE=true in env and update samples to reuse a single client per worker. that'll stop the pattern until we fix.

anna: opened PR w/ fix to shield teardown and add fallback synchronous drain + unit test that cancels during __aexit__: https://github.com/redwood/redwood-py/pull/745 (WIP).

infra-bot: note: increased ephemeral port range on canaries; monitoring for CLOSE_WAIT drop.

ci-bot: CI for PR #745 queued.

morgan: plan: land shield + test, backport to 1.1.x, update examples & a short devex note about client reuse. thanks! :thumbsup:
